name: Catgirl: Panic!
source: This Free, non-hentai game was released as a way of helping people get to know the top staff members at Kuroi Games.  This crazy comedy revolves around the staff of Kuroi Games as they deal with everyday issues such as: a crazy boss, angry penguins, and alien invasions.
translation: 这款免费、非成人游戏旨在帮助玩家了解Kuroi Games的核心工作人员。故事是一部疯狂喜剧，围绕Kuroi Games的员工展开；他们必须处理各种日常问题，比如疯狂的老板、愤怒的企鹅，以及外星人入侵。
